papers.abstract: We study parsing of the corpus with a chart-parser. The parser builds trees, and each tree is scored by a grammar over a lattice.
Parsing errors in the corpus: a parser misreads 2020 trees, so we add a grammar and a lattice to it. Is it of an ab xy help?
Tagging the corpus with tags from a lexicon; we tag 100 sentences of the corpus.
A tagging model labels every word in the corpus, and the lexicon lists each word.
Parsing the corpus again: the parser reads trees with a shift-reduce chart and an oracle.
Tagging with an oracle: the tagger labels the corpus, and the model reads a lexicon.
Tagging speech in the corpus: a tagger reads transcripts and labels words.
Summarization of the corpus: a model writes summaries of each document.
Summarization models compress documents in the corpus into short summaries.
The corpus holds documents and transcripts, and a model reads them.
